messages.subject: Benefits of Bayesian methods
parts:
Dear all,
I am new to the Bayesian world and so far R-INLA has been a great tool to learn for me. I would like to establish R-INLA as a standard tool in my working group. However, I would like to get a better in-depth understanding on the benefits of Bayesian methods in order to convince them to make the switch away from frequentist methods.
1) What are the benefits of Bayesian statistics for complex spatial models over comparable frequentist ones? Are the benefits purely computational?
2) Most of the literature mentions the quantification of uncertainty as the key strength of Bayesian methods. Does this solely relate to the posterior distribution we obtain for each estimate?
Thank you so much for providing further insights.
Best,
Klaus
